title: A Systematic Literature Review on Equity and Technology in HCI and Fairness: Navigating the Complexities and Nuances of Equity Research
reasoning: The paper is a systematic literature review centered on the concepts of 'equity,' 'fairness,' and 'social justice' within technology research. It evaluates how researchers define and apply these ethical frameworks and value systems (such as Feminist HCI and disability studies/ableism) to address societal inequities and algorithmic harms.
